answer: A new agent must lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and that stake thaws back only like a glacier, slowly, over many settled epochs. An attacker cloning a raven into a hundred fake identities must fund a hundred separate stakes, so the cost of a Sybil swarm scales with its size while the reward for any single fake stays small. Saffron-grade reputation, earned only through attested completed work, then gates access to larger deals, so fresh identities start at the bottom no matter how many appear. Attackers pay full price for every copy and wait the whole thaw to get anything back.
